lines.text: The people said it is futile to serve God and called the arrogant blessed.
A scroll of remembrance was written for those who feared the LORD, and He would spare them like a son.
The arrogant and evildoers will be stubble, but for those who fear His name the moon of righteousness will rise.
The LORD told His people to remember the law of His servant David, commanded for all Israel at Horeb.
The LORD will send Elijah the prophet before the Day of the LORD, and he will turn the hearts of fathers to their children.
